hints.jkp/Characteristics.zip: One CSV per country, named <iso3>.csv; all share the same header. Pipeline keeps eom >= 19910000 and requires gvkey.
hints.msci/*: Pipeline reads the first 30 columns (usecols=range(30)). IVA_RATING_DATE format differs by file: yyyymmdd int (2007-2013, 2015-2018), m/d/yy (2014), m/d/YYYY (2019-2022). AS_OF_DATE is yyyymmdd int in all files. ISSUER_ISIN must be non-missing to be used.
hints.sustainalytics/sust_indicator_all.zip: Long format: one row per (EntityId, FieldName, FieldDate). Pipeline pivots on FieldName; the FieldName value set matters.
hints.linking/*: startdate/enddate are yyyymmdd strings, with literal 'B' (beginning) and 'E' (end) sentinels. companyid is the numeric Capital IQ company id; the pipeline builds CIQ_ID = 'IQ' + str(companyid), so role ciq_id (IQ-prefixed string) and role ciq_companyid (int) are the same universe.
hints.morningstar/Morningstar_holdings_*.csv: Wide format: 8 fixed columns then one column per month-end ('YYYY-MM-DD 00:00:00') holding the portfolio weight in percent. Rows are (fund secid, holding ISIN). Pipeline keeps Detail Holding Type == 'EQUITY'. NOTE: the real header has no secid column in the fixed 8; the pipeline lower-cases and reads 'secid' — check the profile for the exact fixed-column list.
fund_size is a quoted string with thousands separators ('22,705,723.00'). ym is 'YYYY-MM'.
hints.other/crsp_dsenames.csv: Used in R to attach ticker/comnam by permno over [namedt, nameendt].
hints.trucost/trucost.zip: di_323615_text (effective date) is a text timestamp like 'Jan 15 2020 12:00AM'; the pipeline keeps the first 11 characters and parses them with pd.to_datetime. gvkey is missing for most rows in the real file; only rows with gvkey are usable.
hints.dates: Date profiles carry 'sentinels' when a few values do not match the format (e.g. 'B'/'E' in the linking tables); the generator should reproduce those at the stated share.

jkp/Characteristics.zip.note: columns profiled = the usecols the pipeline reads; all_columns lists the full header
